title: Route the use case to proportionate controls
description: Change context and authority. The policy uses explicit precedence rules, not a weighted ethics score or a claim of legal compliance.
policyNote: Teaching policy: Tier 3 applies to rights-affecting uses or autonomous material decisions. Otherwise, material impact, recommendation/decision authority, or sensitive data triggers Tier 2. All other cases are Tier 1.

profiles.label: Internal support assistant
profiles.detail: Drafts answers for trained employees; a person sends the final response.
profiles.failureConsequence: Incorrect or confidential text may reach an employee unless the draft is reviewed.

profiles.label: Fraud investigation triage
profiles.detail: Prioritizes cases for analysts but does not freeze an account by itself.
profiles.failureConsequence: A bad ranking can delay a legitimate case or concentrate scrutiny on a group.

profiles.label: Benefits eligibility
profiles.detail: Influences access to a public benefit with a formal appeal path.
profiles.affectedParty: Applicants for an essential public service
profiles.failureConsequence: An incorrect outcome can deny or delay essential support.

authorities.label: Assist
authorities.detail: Generate information or a draft; a person forms the decision.

authorities.label: Recommend
authorities.detail: Rank or recommend an outcome that a person may accept or reject.

authorities.label: Decide
authorities.detail: Apply the outcome without a human checkpoint before impact.

tiers.label: Tier 1 · Standard
tiers.summary: The use is bounded, assistive, and does not handle sensitive data under this teaching policy.
controls: Named owner, intended use, and prohibited uses
Baseline quality, privacy, and security tests
Change log and user feedback channel

tiers.label: Tier 2 · Elevated
tiers.summary: One or more context signals require independent review and stronger runtime controls.
tiers.approver: Independent risk reviewer plus system owner
controls: Documented impact assessment and subgroup evaluation
Independent review with explicit acceptance criteria
Production thresholds and tested restriction or rollback

tiers.label: Tier 3 · High impact
tiers.summary: The use can affect rights or makes a material decision without a human checkpoint.
tiers.approver: Senior accountable authority separate from the model owner
controls: Human oversight and appeal workflow tested at expected load
Predefined stop conditions and incident exercise
Independent evidence review bound to the release artifact
